name: Hoshifuru Natsu
source:
Main character becomes interested in sword fighting, so this summer he trains at his father best friend's dojo. It's supposed to be harsh training, but three girls who live at this place make it rather enjoyable. Protagonist never had a girlfriend, so he is often puzzled by the unpredictable behavior of the girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角对剑术产生了兴趣，于是在这个夏天来到父亲挚友的道场修行。本应严苛的训练，却因为住在这里的三个女孩而变得愉快。主角从未交过女朋友，女孩们难以捉摸的举动常常令他不知所措。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
